name: closeSessionTab
description: Close one of a chat session's tabs in this Nexus window: the browser pane's tab-strip close. Refused for a tab the session does not own.

inputs.name: sessionId
inputs.description: The owning chat session's id; the tab must carry its tag.

inputs.name: tabId
inputs.description: The tab's id as published in the session's tab list (the tab handle).
